title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B (nemotron_h_moe): LatentMoE expert FFN + Mamba-2 block assembly
author: LLM Bridge
scope: Executable architecture-level modules with independent FP64 validation. This is component-level validation only; it is NOT a full 120B inference run (see full_model_inference_status).

relevant_commits.summary: feat(mamba2): assemble complete Mamba-2 block from conv + SSM cores
feat(moe): executable Nemotron LatentMoE expert FFN with f64 oracle
fix(moe): nemotron LatentMoE routing uses sigmoid gating, not softmax
feat(mamba2): selective state-space (SSM) scan with recurrent state
feat(mamba2): causal depthwise convolution with persistent state
feat(native): type-generic bounded quantized matrix-vector product
feat(core): multi-shard GGUF indexing + IQ2_XXS/IQ4_NL geometry

authoritative_sources: build/reference/src/models/nemotron-h-moe.cpp (FFN sub-layer wiring: shared expert + latent projections + MoE)
build/reference/src/llama-graph.cpp build_moe_ffn (per-expert math, gating, selection bias, norm, scale)

exact_recipe: router_logits = ffn_gate_inp . x        (on the full n_embd input)
shexp = ffn_down_shexp . relu2(ffn_up_shexp . x)   (shared expert, on full x)
per selected expert e: u = relu2(ffn_up_exps[e] . lat); d = ffn_down_exps[e] . u; moe += weight[e] * d
ffn_out = moe + shexp                    (block adds the residual afterwards)
latentmoe_ffn.expert_activation: squared ReLU relu(v)^2 (LLM_FFN_RELU_SQR), up+down, NO gate
latentmoe_ffn.selection_bias: ffn_exp_probs_b affects ranking only; expert weights come from the UNBIASED sigmoid probabilities
latentmoe_ffn.weight_norm: sum clamped to F16 minimum 6.103515625e-5 then divide
latentmoe_ffn.accumulation: f32 matvec (mirrors ggml CPU path); only selected experts evaluated (sparse compute)

independent_validation.oracle: separate FP64 oracle in latent_moe_ffn.rs tests (no shared code with the production path)
deterministic_fixtures_source_linked: multiple_experts_match_oracle_with_metrics: separated router -> selected expert_ids = [15,14,13,12,11]; normalized+scaled weights sum = 5.0
real_nemotron_config_shapes_route_22_of_512: 22 of 512 selected; weights sum = 5.0; matches sigmoid oracle
selection_bias_changes_rank_but_not_weight_value: bias pulls expert 0 to rank 0; its weight stays the unbiased sigmoid prob in (0,1]
squared_relu_zeroes_negative_preactivations: negative up-projection -> routed path vanishes, output == shared expert alone
independent_validation.regression_against_old_defect: regression_sigmoid_differs_from_softmax_defect: production matches the sigmoid oracle (max_abs < 1e-3) and is NOT the softmax oracle (diff > 1e-3); sigmoid and softmax pick different weights

exact_composition: zxBCdt = ssm_in . cur (in-projection to d_in_proj = 2*d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state + n_head)
split: z = [0,d_inner); xBC = [d_inner, d_inner + (d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state)); dt = last n_head
xBC = ssm_conv(conv_state, xBC) over d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state channels
split xBC: x = d_inner; B = n_group*d_state; C = n_group*d_state
y = ssm_scan(ssm_state, x, dt, A, B, C)  (scalar-A Mamba-2 branch; softplus(dt) inside)
y = y + x * D  (per-head D skip, broadcast over head_dim)
y = grouped_rms_norm(y) * ssm_norm  (n_group groups, eps = ssm_norm_eps)
mamba2_block.state: persistent, session-local conv state (d_conv-1 per channel) + SSM state (n_head*head_dim*d_state); dt bias and gating each applied exactly once

independent_validation.oracle: wholly separate FP64 re-derivation (its own conv and scan) in mamba2_block.rs tests
